description: Additional synchronization sequence cases for remote pull, local deletion propagation, and retry after remote write failure.

cases.description: A remote-only file is pulled locally and persisted into store state on the first successful sync.
After an initial successful sync, a local deletion is propagated to the remote on the next sync.
cases.expected_output:
step=0
notice=[["Checking for changes..."],["Uploading local changes"],["Writing remote changes to local"],["Sync successful"]]
success=true
local_ops=[]
remote_ops=[{"path":"gone.md","type":"ADDED"}]
clashes=[]
step=1
notice=[["Checking for changes..."],["Uploading local changes"],["Writing remote changes to local"],["Sync successful"]]
success=true
local_ops=[]
remote_ops=[{"path":"gone.md","type":"REMOVED"}]
clashes=[]
local_files={}
remote_files={}
store={"lastFetchedCommitSha":"da39a3ee5e6b4b0d3255bfef95601890afd80709","lastFetchedRemoteSha":{},"localSha":{}}

cases.description: A remote failure during upload leaves local state intact so the following retry can upload the accumulated file.
cases.expected_output:
step=0
notice=[["Checking for changes..."]]
success=false
error_message=temporary outage. Please check your internet connection.
step=1
notice=[["Checking for changes..."],["Uploading local changes"],["Writing remote changes to local"],["Sync successful"]]
success=true
local_ops=[]
remote_ops=[{"path":"retry.md","type":"ADDED"}]
clashes=[]
local_files={"retry.md":{"content":"first","encoding":"plaintext"}}
remote_files={"retry.md":{"content":"first","encoding":"plaintext"}}
store={"lastFetchedCommitSha":"44208224dae5a13b994d1a791aae4fc7a0b5da26","lastFetchedRemoteSha":{"retry.md":"8aa194506db78ae87c7d01d98e5f5ea6e05b3f36"},"localSha":{"retry.md":"bba3c0fe8b8e6225e8dd42b9209dd38abcc44bc9"}}
